en: The image shows an old sepia-toned photograph of a large, ornate building set against a forested hillside. The architecture appears grand and symmetrical, with a central clock tower and wings extending on both sides. The foreground includes some trees and a fence, with a smaller building or barn to the right. The bottom of the postcard contains text in a decorative script.
